tasks.label: List dev processes
tasks.command: ps -eo pid,ppid,cmd | grep -E 'eve|next dev|node' | grep -v grep

tasks.label: Stop eve dev processes
tasks.command: kill 242314 242316 242329 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; ps -p 242314,242316,242329 -o pid,cmd 2>/dev/null || echo 'eve dev processes stopped'

tasks.label: Force stop eve dev
tasks.command: kill -9 242316 242329 2>/dev/null; pkill -9 -f 'eve/dist/src/cli/dev' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; ps -eo pid,ppid,cmd | grep -E 'eve dev|eve/dist/src/cli' | grep -v grep || echo 'eve dev fully stopped'

tasks.label: Sjekk OS og maskinvare
tasks.command: echo '=== OS ==='; head -3 /etc/os-release; echo '=== RAM ==='; free -h; echo '=== CPU kjerner ==='; nproc; echo '=== installert? ==='; command -v node git ollama 2>/dev/null; node -v 2>/dev/null

tasks.label: Finn eksakte stier
tasks.command: echo 'npm:'; command -v npm; echo 'node:'; command -v node; echo 'eve bin:'; readlink -f node_modules/.bin/eve 2>/dev/null; echo 'npm global root:'; npm root -g 2>/dev/null; echo 'web env example:'; ls -a web/ | grep -i env

tasks.label: Finn lagringssteder
tasks.command: echo '=== OLLAMA_MODELS env ==='; echo "${OLLAMA_MODELS:-(ikke satt, bruker standard)}"; echo '=== Modeller ==='; ollama list 2>/dev/null; echo '=== ~/.ollama/models ==='; ls -la ~/.ollama/models/ 2>/dev/null; echo '=== deploy-mappe ==='; ls -la deploy/ 2>/dev/null; echo '=== .eve (agentdata) ==='; ls ${workspaceFolder}/.eve/ 2>/dev/null

tasks.label: Sjekk ollama lagring og pull-status
tasks.command: echo '=== ollama tjeneste ==='; ps aux | grep -i '[o]llama' | head -5; echo '=== modellmappe (service-bruker) ==='; ls -la /usr/share/ollama/.ollama/models/ 2>/dev/null; echo '=== ollama list ==='; ollama list 2>/dev/null

tasks.label: Sjekk public/index.html
tasks.command: ls -la public/; echo '---'; wc -c public/index.html; echo '---'; ls -la public/index.html; echo '--- readlink ---'; readlink -f public/index.html

tasks.label: Diagnostikk: GPU/Ollama/porter
tasks.command: echo '=== GPU ==='; nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv 2>/dev/null || echo 'ingen NVIDIA GPU'; echo '=== VGA ==='; lspci 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'vga|3d' || echo 'lspci utilgjengelig'; echo '=== ollama ==='; command -v ollama && ollama list 2>/dev/null; echo '=== ollama prosess ==='; ps aux | grep -i '[o]llama' | head -5; echo '=== porter ==='; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':2000|:3000|:11434' || echo 'ingen aktive porter (2000/3000/11434)'; echo '=== RAM ==='; free -h | head -2; echo '=== CPU ==='; nproc

tasks.label: Hent AI Gateway modelliste
tasks.command: curl -s https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models | head -c 4000; echo; echo '--- grep free/laguna ---'; curl -s https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models | grep -oiE '[a-z0-9._/-]*(free|laguna)[a-z0-9._/-]*' | sort -u | head -40

tasks.label: Sjekk public/index.html
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder} && ls -la public/ && wc -c public/index.html && readlink -f public/index.html

tasks.label: Finn server-IP og router-adresse
tasks.command: echo '=== Din server sin lokale IP ==='; hostname -I; echo '=== Standard gateway (routerens adresse) ==='; ip route | grep default; echo '=== Offentlig IP ==='; curl -s https://api.ipify.org && echo

tasks.label: Sjekk service-status og agent-logg
tasks.command: echo '=== myai-web status ==='; systemctl status myai-web --no-pager 2>&1 | head -25; echo; echo '=== agent: siste logg ==='; journalctl -u myai-agent --no-pager -n 40 2>&1 | tail -45; echo; echo '=== agent helse ==='; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'health HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:2000/eve/v1/health; echo '=== porter ==='; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':2000|:3000'

tasks.label: Sjekk caddy, porter og DNS
tasks.command: echo '=== caddy status ==='; systemctl status caddy --no-pager 2>&1 | head -12; echo; echo '=== porter (80/443/3000/2000) ==='; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':80|:443|:3000|:2000'; echo; echo '=== caddy logg (siste 15) ==='; journalctl -u caddy --no-pager -n 15 2>&1 | tail -15; echo; echo '=== web-app lokalt ==='; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'localhost:3000 -> HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:3000/; echo '=== DNS-oppslag ==='; getent hosts tech-ai.tech www.tech-ai.tech 2>&1 || echo 'DNS svarer ikke enda (venter på propagering)'

tasks.label: Finn hva som bruker port 80
tasks.command: echo '=== hva svarer på port 80? ==='; curl -s -i http://127.0.0.1:80/ 2>&1 | head -15; echo; echo '=== mulige web-servere ==='; systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'nginx|apache|httpd|lighttpd|caddy|python|uvicorn|gunicorn' || echo 'ingen kjente web-servere i listen'; echo; echo '=== alle kjørende tjenester (utvalg) ==='; systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-pager 2>/dev/null | head -40

tasks.label: Sjekk om apache fortsatt holder port 80
tasks.command: systemctl is-active apache2 2>&1; echo '---'; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':80|:443' ; echo '---'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'port 80 -> HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:80/

tasks.label: Les Caddyfile og caddy-loggen
tasks.command: echo '=== Caddyfile som caddy faktisk bruker ==='; cat /etc/caddy/Caddyfile; echo; echo '=== porter ==='; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':80|:443'; echo; echo '=== caddy full logg (siste 25) ==='; journalctl -u caddy --no-pager -n 25 -o cat 2>&1 | tail -25

tasks.label: Verifiser at caddy svarer lokalt
tasks.command: echo '=== lokal HTTP (port 80) ==='; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:80/; echo '=== lokal HTTPS (port 443, ignorer sertifikat) ==='; curl -sk -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' https://127.0.0.1:443/ 2>&1; echo '=== er 80/443 bundet av caddy? ==='; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':80|:443'

tasks.label: Sjekk lokal brannmur (ufw/firewalld)
tasks.command: echo '=== ufw aktiv? ==='; systemctl is-active ufw 2>&1; echo '=== firewalld aktiv? ==='; systemctl is-active firewalld 2>&1; echo '=== ufw status (uten sudo hvis mulig) ==='; ufw status 2>&1 | head -10

tasks.label: Test eksterne porter og sertifikat-status
tasks.command: echo '=== ekstern port-skan av 176.11.4.127 (vanlige porter) ==='; curl -s --max-time 30 'https://api.hackertarget.com/nmap/?q=176.11.4.127' 2>&1 | head -40; echo; echo '=== caddy: sertifikat-status ==='; journalctl -u caddy --no-pager -n 25 -o cat 2>&1 | grep -iE 'certificate obtained|serving|error|obtain' | tail -15

tasks.label: Sjekk cloudflared og caddy
tasks.command: echo '=== cloudflared installert? ==='; command -v cloudflared && cloudflared --version 2>&1 | head -2 || echo 'cloudflared IKKE installert'; echo; echo '=== cloudflared som tjeneste? ==='; systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -i cloudflared || echo 'ingen cloudflared-tjeneste'; echo; echo '=== caddy kjører fortsatt? ==='; systemctl is-active caddy 2>&1

tasks.label: Sjekk git-status og hemmeligheter
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}; echo '=== ROOT repo: remote ==='; git remote -v 2>&1; echo '=== ROOT repo: branch/status (kort) ==='; git branch --show-current 2>&1; git status --short 2>&1 | head -40; echo; echo '=== er web en egen git-repo? ==='; ls -d web/.git 2>/dev/null && (cd web && git remote -v 2>&1) || echo 'web er ikke egen repo'; echo; echo '=== sjekk at hemmeligheter IKKE spores ==='; git check-ignore .env.local .env.agent .env web/.env.local 2>&1

tasks.label: Sjekk GitHub-autentisering
tasks.command: echo '=== GitHub CLI (gh) ==='; command -v gh && gh auth status 2>&1 | head -8 || echo 'gh ikke installert'; echo; echo '=== SSH-nøkler ==='; ls -la ~/.ssh/*.pub 2>/dev/null || echo 'ingen SSH-pubkey'; echo; echo '=== git config user ==='; git -C ${workspaceFolder} config user.name; git -C ${workspaceFolder} config user.email

tasks.label: Oppdater git-remote til nytt reponavn
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}; git remote set-url origin https://github.com/Salazar-Rivero-Smart-Things/tech-ai-monkey.git; echo '=== ny remote ==='; git remote -v; echo; echo '=== kan vi nå repoet? ==='; GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git ls-remote origin 2>&1 | head -6

tasks.label: Sjekk GitHub-innlogging og repo-plassering
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}; echo '=== gh auth ==='; gh auth status 2>&1 | head -6; echo; echo '=== dine repoer ==='; gh repo list --limit 50 2>&1; echo; echo '=== tester org-URL ==='; GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git ls-remote origin 2>&1 | head -4

tasks.label: Finn riktig repo og organisasjon
tasks.command: echo '=== dine organisasjoner ==='; gh api user/orgs --jq '.[].login' 2>&1; echo; echo '=== repoer i Salazar-Rivero-Smart-Things ==='; gh api orgs/Salazar-Rivero-Smart-Things/repos --jq '.[].full_name' 2>&1 | head -20; echo; echo '=== søk etter tech-ai-monkey ==='; gh repo list Salazar-Rivero-Smart-Things --limit 50 2>&1 | head -20

tasks.label: Gi repoet nytt navn og sjekk web-repo
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}; echo '=== rename repo ==='; gh api -X PATCH repos/Salazar-Rivero-Smart-Things/Tech-AI-Monkey-v1 -f name=tech-ai-monkey --jq '.full_name' 2>&1; echo; echo '=== .gitmodules? ==='; ls -la .gitmodules 2>&1; echo '=== web git-historikk ==='; cd web && git log --oneline 2>&1 | head -5; echo '=== web status ==='; git status --short 2>&1 | head -20

tasks.label: Klargjør commit (konverter web, stage alt)
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}; echo '=== fjern web som submodule/gitlink ==='; git rm --cached web 2>&1; rm -rf web/.git; echo '=== stage alt ==='; git add -A 2>&1; echo '=== hva blir med i commiten? (filer) ==='; git diff --cached --name-only | head -80; echo; echo '=== SJEKK: noen hemmelige .env-filer med? ==='; git diff --cached --name-only | grep -iE '\.env|secret|credential' || echo 'INGEN hemmelige filer er med ✓'

tasks.label: Diagnostikk: Node og npm
args: echo '=== node ==='; node -v; echo '=== npm ==='; npm -v; echo '=== cwd ==='; pwd; echo '=== OS ==='; cat /etc/os-release | head -3

tasks.label: Diag: miljo
args: OUT=$PWD/.diag.txt; { echo '=== node ==='; node -v; echo '=== npm ==='; npm -v; echo '=== npx ==='; npx -v; echo '=== whoami/home ==='; whoami; echo $HOME; echo '=== OS ==='; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -4; echo '=== DB binaries ==='; command -v psql || echo 'no psql'; command -v mariadb || echo 'no mariadb'; command -v mysql || echo 'no mysql'; echo '=== DB services ==='; systemctl list-units --type=service --all 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'postgres|mysql|mariadb' || echo 'none'; echo '=== disk ==='; df -h / | tail -1; } > "$OUT" 2>&1; echo done

tasks.label: Setup: sjekk DB-auth og gammel deploy
Diag: tjenester, porter, cloudflared, stier
args: cd "$HOME" && echo '=== SERVICES ===' ; systemctl is-active myai-agent myai-web caddy cloudflared 2>&1 ; echo ; echo '=== UNIT FILES ===' ; for u in myai-agent myai-web caddy; do echo "--- $u ---"; systemctl cat $u 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'WorkingDirectory|ExecStart|EnvironmentFile|^User=' ; done ; echo ; echo '=== PORTS ===' ; sudo -n ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(80|443|2000|3000|8000|8080|8443) ' ; echo ; echo '=== CLOUDFLARED ===' ; pgrep -a cloudflared || echo 'ikke kjorende' ; ls -la "$HOME/.cloudflared" 2>&1 ; echo ; echo '=== PATHS ===' ; for p in ${workspaceFolder} /run/media/hesriverp7/1CF66753F6672C68/MyGits/Tech-ai-monkey/tech-ai-monkey ; do if [ -d "$p" ]; then echo "OK     $p"; else echo "MANGLER $p"; fi; done

tasks.label: Diag: sudo og gamle stier
args: echo '=== sudo -n ==='; sudo -n true 2>&1; echo "sudo_exit=$?"; echo '=== /etc/sudoers.d ==='; ls -la /etc/sudoers.d/ 2>&1; echo '=== Dokumenter/MyGits ==='; ls -la /home/hesriverp7/Dokumenter/MyGits/ 2>&1 | head; echo '=== gammel prosjektsti finnes? ==='; [ -e ${workspaceFolder} ] && echo FINNES || echo MANGLER

tasks.label: Diag: systemd-stier
args: echo '=== units som nevner Dokumenter/MyGits eller /run/media ==='; grep -rIn -e 'Dokumenter' -e 'MyGits' -e '/run/media' /etc/systemd/system /etc/systemd/user "$HOME/.config/systemd" 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo; echo '=== alle myai/monkey/tech units ==='; systemctl list-unit-files --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'myai|monkey|tech|caddy|servidor|apache|nginx'; echo; echo '=== kjørende tjenester (utvalg) ==='; systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'myai|monkey|tech|caddy|servidor|apache|nginx|postgres|ollama'
